topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I shouldn't have taken the case. The rain was coming down hard, soaking through my coat as I stood there, staring at the wall. The artist's work—pieces he'd poured his soul into—now marred by someone's crude attempt to make a statement. The ink wasn't even dry. I ran my fingers over it, knowing I should have seen this coming. The city's underbelly is full of wannabes looking for a shortcut to fame. I made a promise to find out who did this, but as I stood there, the rain wasn't the only thing clouding my vision. Some deals are too good to be true, and I walked right into this one.
